steps.text: TOOLS BUG-2b (FIX_PLAN_v2 TOOLS: scanner microprint, deferred to #13): at A2, on a planted ReprintedPaper case (re-enabled at #17; until then any paper that prints a microprint line), scan the paper and open its copy (normal layer): the read must not be credited yet (uncredited). Then open the scan view's UV layer (UI-PC's ScanLayerSwitch prints the line with MicroprintView.Print) and measure. Pass: tools.micro.a2.cap >=12 px (MicroprintView.CapPx, 0 when clipped, off screen or covered), tools.micro.a2.pixels (independent: the screenshot's ink >=12 px tall across >=80% of the line), tools.micro.a2_before.uncredited and tools.micro.a2.credited (DeskReadings.MicroRead), and the still read by eye. Retarget 'MicroprintRow' to the object UI-PC names at #13; 'n' is the paper's index in the case.
UI-PC #13: drag the paper onto the scanner and open its copy on the PC (normal layer).
